title: SG-2.3 · The Boy's Room asset folders and manifest referencing real files
summary: Create the public asset folder tree for the-boys-room and ui, plus a manifest that references real files.
description: Context: game/ has a typed manifest schema (game/src/assets/manifest) but no game/public/assets tree and no manifest file. Desired behavior: worlds/the-boys-room/{backgrounds,furniture,objects,characters,effects,audio} and ui/{icons,frames,cursors} exist and hold real temporary pixel-art assets, and a manifest.json lists them and passes the existing validator. Expected result: every manifest path resolves to a file on disk. Why: future AI cycles can add or replace assets without touching the engine.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, when the folders are listed, then all 6 world folders and 3 ui folders exist under game/public/assets and each holds at least one file
Given the manifest.json, when parseManifest runs, then it returns ok with unique ids
Given the manifest, when each asset path is resolved against game/public/assets, then every file exists

in_scope: game/public/assets folder tree with temporary assets
manifest file loader that checks files exist

technical_constraints: Manifest must satisfy manifestSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
Assets are temporary and must be documented as such
definition_of_done: All three requirements delivered and verified by unit tests
